text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: region-health-eu failover monitor fired (high p99 latency + 5xx increase) - alert_id=RH-EU-003 - current: p99=1.8s (+120%), 5xx_rate=3.6% (+2.9pp). auto-failover not triggered (threshold=5%).

Ava (oncall): I'm on it. seeing elevated latency across eu-west clusters, client-facing API 502/504 spikes. tagging @nora for CS triage.

Nora - support: getting a handful of customer complaints about timeouts in EU region. collecting examples, will loop in account teams.

Ava (oncall): quick triage:
- checked region health dashboard: https://redwood.infra/dashboards/region-health-eu (p95 normal-ish, p99 jumped)
- routing table looks normal, but CPU on inference-pool-3 is spiking
- KV cache miss rate up from 8% -> 41% in last 10m

Priya - infra: I see autoscaler kicks earlier this morning, but current pod count is healthy. looking at GPU queue depth:
```
gpu_queue_depth { pod: "inference-pool-3-7f6b" value: 320 }
gpu_queue_depth { pod: "inference-pool-3-9d2a" value: 305 }
```
Those queue depths are high for that flavor. any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: deploy finished: release/2026-03-15.2 -> eu-west (inference-service) by @liam - 10:12UTC

Liam - eng-platform: yes pushed a small scheduler tweak at 10:12 to improve packing. rolling back now to validate. rolling back to release/2026-03-15.1

Ava (oncall): rollback started. while that runs, doing short mitigation:
- disable prefix batching on eu-inference route (will increase token cost but lower queue head-of-line)
- increase inference-worker concurrency to allow more inflight single-token work

Jonas - eng-sre: add note: we should avoid full auto-failover while we have degraded capacity but not full outage. flagging the failover alert thresholds as noisy.

Ava (oncall): confirmed rollback success, pods restarted, queue depth trending down. KV miss rate still high but falling. p99 dropping to 980ms now.

Nora - support: customers updated; early report from a large EU customer saying latency improved, they're seeing fewer client retries.

Priya - infra: quick post-incident tuning proposal:
- reduce RH-EU-003 sensitivity: raise auto-failover threshold from 5% 5xx to 7% for p99>1.5s transient spikes
- add a medium-duration alert (5m sustained p99>1.5s + 5xx>2.5%) to prompt manual review before auto-failover
- create per-pool queue-depth dashboard with per-GPU queue histograms

Ava (oncall): agreed. also: add a runbook step to prefer rolling rollback of recent scheduler-like changes before failover. created quick ticket RN-487 for runbook edit.

Jonas - eng-sre: I'll pick up follow-ups tomorrow. immediate tasks:
- Priya to add queue-depth panels and a synthetic traffic probe for eu-west (low-RPS synthetic to detect queuing)
- Liam to add deploy guard for scheduler changes to require canary in EU for 30m before global rollout
- Ava to add alert throttle rules so RH-EU-003 doesn't page for <3m spikes

Priya - infra: started dashboard PR: https://redwood.infra/dashboards/pr/432 - adding histograms + aggregation by GPU flavor. ETA 6h.

Liam - eng-platform: will add deploy guard change as a policy PR. also propose an automated mitigation: if gpu_queue_depth > 250 for >2m, scale a hot-pool and pause new global routing to EU. filing CL-210.

Ava (oncall): handing over shift to Jonas - leaving checklist: rollback verified, alerts muted for short spikes, support alerted, ticket RN-487 created.

Jonas - eng-sre: taking over. I will monitor for 30m then schedule follow-up retro. tagging @team-eng-sre for post-incident review.

Nora - support: will continue to collect impact windows and affected customer list; I'll attach to RN-487.

Ava (oncall): final: post-incident action items (PIA):
- update RH-EU-003 thresholds and add intermediate alert (owner: Jonas)
- dashboard PR (owner: Priya)
- deploy guard policy (owner: Liam)
- runbook RN-487 edits: include rollback-first preference and queue-depth checks (owner: Jonas)
- CS outreach pack (owner: Nora)

Jonas - eng-sre: noted. I'll open a short incident blameless post with timeline and add metric plots. next actions scheduled in #incidents-ops.

incident-bot: incident resolved: RH-EU-003 state -> recovered. summary metrics: peak p99 1.83s at 1876543312, failover not triggered.

Ava (oncall): thanks all :thumbsup: good handoff.
